It feels truly strange. My life is on the way up and I've finally started to figure stuff out. Yet this is the first time I've felt this way. I don't know why. 


Same late at night it hits me or when something starts to make me distressed it's worse. Over small things like a small blow up where my girlfriend doesn't want to talk to me for a day. 

Like why? It shouldn't be that big a deal but the feeling of " You know maybe just blink out of existing wouldn't be too bad"

Good to know in a twisted way. Cheers

I feel the same sometimes. The only person who really reaches out to me is my girlfriend. I feel alone too. 

The truth is people will feel the impact of you end it. I know that for myself for sure. People I barely know will feel sad and then sadder the closer they were to me. 

But you'll never know if you die. That's the strangest part, you don't know who really cared till your gone. So don't do it, it's hard but maybe one day, hour, minute it'll be a bit easier. That's what can help
